adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `blacklistedGuestEmails` is built with `.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`, but the filter checks `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` where `guest` is used verbatim (not lowercased). This allows case-variant emails (e.g., `SPAM@evil.com`) to bypass a blacklist entry `spam@evil.com`.
